title: Cancel/delete with external work in flight (VI.5)
database: PostgreSQL 17 (Testcontainers postgres:17-alpine), one database per engine

scenarios.name: Delete while the payment worker is mid-call; the worker then completes: 410 GONE, late result audited, LATE_RESULT_AFTER_DELETE item, instance stays deleted

measurements.rawAdapterLateCompleteWithoutTombstoneCh: org.flowable.common.engine.api.FlowableObjectNotFoundException: No External Worker job found for id: 43

scenarios.name: Delete while the worker holds the lease and never answers: the tombstoned lease expires without cancel ack and becomes UNKNOWN_OUTCOME (VI.5 rule 4)
Late fail / outcomeUnknown after delete: 410; an item only when an effect may have happened; instance stays deleted

notes.deleteCommand: one engine transaction: Tombstones.write per leased work of the root (from SPIKE_LEASE + the work->operation map), Tombstones.recordDeletion (INSTANCE_DELETED audit with open operationIds), EngineAdapter.cancelInstance
notes.lateResultPath: PaymentWorker.complete: Tombstones.onLateResult before the ledger and completeExternal, same transaction
